params.name: Ids
params.description: The IDs of the returns to fetch. Accepts a comma-separated list of return IDs (e.g., 123,456,789).

params.name: ReferenceIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of return reference IDs (RMA numbers) to filter by.

params.name: Status
params.description: Comma-separated list of return statuses to filter by (e.g., AwaitingArrival,Arrived,Processing,Completed,Cancelled).

params.name: FulfillmentCenterIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of fulfillment center IDs to filter by.

params.name: TrackingNumbers
params.description: Comma-separated list of tracking numbers to filter by.

params.name: OriginalShipmentIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of original shipment IDs to filter by.

params.name: InventoryIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of inventory IDs to filter by.

params.name: StartDate
params.description: Filter returns created on or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: EndDate
params.description: Filter returns created on or before this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: ReturnTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of return types to filter by (e.g., Regular,ReturnToSender).

params.name: ReturnActions
params.description: Comma-separated list of return actions to filter by (e.g., Restock,Quarantine,Dispose).

params.name: StoreOrderIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of store order IDs to filter by.

params.name: Sortby
params.description: Field to sort results by.

params.name: CompletedStartDate
params.description: Filter returns completed on or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: CompletedEndDate
params.description: Filter returns completed on or before this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: Cursor
params.description: Page number to retrieve. Used for pagination through result sets.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

params.name: SortOrder
params.description: Sort order for results. Desc = newest to oldest, Asc = oldest to newest, Desc is default
